name: fo-transfer-pricing
description: Assess Faroese controlled transactions, related debt and documentation duties for 2026. Distinguish arm's-length pricing from return disclosure, test the two-year small-business documentation exemption and prepare evidence for a TAKS request. Identify direct, indirect, family and voting control, foreign and domestic counterparties, and permanent-establishment dealings. Check the separate 4:1 thin-capitalisation rule, guaranteed third-party debt, market-value equity and the independent-financing exception. Use for Faroese transfer pricing, management fees, intercompany loans, controlled-transaction disclosure, small-company documentation and related-party interest deductions. CbCR is addressed in its separate Guide. Current return fields, retention duration, treaty procedures and complex debt allocation remain open. Independent AI review accepted partial draft publication; professional attestation is pending.
